title: Cardinal Select Shop Network Guide: Starting Days for Larger-Class Partner Rentals by Repair Path
content:
**Repair path rule (Cardinal Rental Reimbursement).** The starting days of an accepted larger-class partner rental follow the repair path of the claim. The repair path is read from two places: the closings on the claim's rental ledger, and the estimate entries on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim.

| Repair path on the claim | Starting days |
|---|---|
| A rental on the claim closed because repairs were complete, **and** a supplement estimate (estimate sequence 1 or higher) is on the claim, **and** the latest estimate on the claim was written by a Cardinal Select Shop | 4 |
| A rental on the claim closed because repairs were complete, **and** a supplement estimate (estimate sequence 1 or higher) is on the claim, **and** the latest estimate on the claim was written by a shop outside the Select network | 2 |
| Any other repair path | The option's initial authorization days |

## Terms used in the table

- **Rental closed because repairs were complete.** A closing on the rental ledger of the claim whose reason is *repairs complete*. It may be any closed rental on the claim.
- **Supplement estimate.** An estimate written on the physical damage claim with an estimate sequence of 1 or higher. The original estimate carries sequence 0.
- **Latest estimate.** The estimate most recently written on the claim. It shows whether the shop is a Cardinal Select Shop or a shop outside the Select network.

## Combinations

| Closed for repairs complete | Supplement on the claim | Latest estimate written by | Starting days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Cardinal Select Shop | 4 |
| Yes | Yes | Shop outside the Select network | 2 |
| Yes | No (original estimate only) | Either | Initial authorization days |
| No | Yes | Either | Initial authorization days |
| No | No | Either | Initial authorization days |

## Cases (hypothetical claims)

1. A car went back to a Cardinal Select Shop after its first rental closed on repairs complete. The shop wrote estimate sequence 1. A larger-class car accepted now starts with 4 days.
2. The same facts at an independent shop outside the Select network give 2 starting days.
3. A supplement estimate was written while the first rental was still running, and no rental on the claim has closed on repairs complete. The starting days are the option's initial authorization days.
